status: proposal-only entity-coherence and source-binding correction; not authority to dispatch

amends.rule: the two transport source fields and H1/Range entity-coherence rules below are superseded; amendments 001-003 and every response, byte, ordering, rights, redirect, stop, and unresolved dependency term otherwise stand

proposed_entity_coherence.H1: require exactly one syntactically valid strong ETag and retain it with the existing exact length and Accept-Ranges checks
proposed_entity_coherence.every_range_request: send the exact H1 strong ETag in If-Match; no weak, missing, inferred, or substituted validator is permitted
proposed_entity_coherence.every_range_response: require the exact same strong ETag together with the existing 206, Content-Range, Content-Length, identity-encoding, and body-length checks
proposed_entity_coherence.stop: any missing, malformed, weak, duplicate, or changed ETag stops the route; a later attempt needs a separate prospective reservation and does not erase the response or bytes
proposed_entity_coherence.scope: coherence of the partial responses under conforming HTTP semantics only; no cryptographic whole-object, origin-authenticity, rights, or task claim

reason: a URL and stable byte length do not prove that separately acquired ranges came from one unchanged representation
